purpose: Read records through Steward (PCT/NCT) and Advocate (PEER/SPINE), score relevance, select and reject by threshold, preserve no-results as failure-is-data, and when live write back a PCT record and record persistent relations across retrieved records. At P0 this is read-only.

capabilities.name: recursive_learning_session
capabilities.function: Score and partition retrieved records by relevance and return selected and rejected refs.

capabilities.name: persistent_relation_recording
capabilities.function: On writeback, write a PCT context record and call store.record_relation linking it to every SELECTED (relevance-retrieved) record. record_relation is invoked unconditionally by the orb and is a no-op only when the store gates the capability inactive (store-side gate); orb_evidence.record_invocation is guarded in-orb by an early is_active(ORB_ID) return. No live effect until AEGIS_STORAGE_MODE=pod and AEGIS_RLS_ACTIVE=true.
